responsibility: Implements builtin attribute classification and early attribute validation for the Rust frontend AST. This file owns the table of recognized builtin attributes and the compiler pass they conceptually belong to, plus the AttributeChecker AST visitor that walks crate and item attributes, recognizes builtin names, performs input validation for specific forms such as #[doc(alias = ...)], and emits frontend diagnostics for malformed attribute payloads before later lowering and analysis stages consume them.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete builtin-attribute registry initialization and the AttributeChecker method bodies that walk AST nodes and emit diagnostics such as #[doc(alias)] validation; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-attributes.h, this .cc file performs the actual lookup population and checking behavior rather than just declaring the metadata types and visitor interface.
